_comment: KF-S0-CONTRACT-001: `lib` adds DOM to the base's ES2022. The typed fetch client (src/client.ts) uses fetch, Headers, Response, URL and AbortSignal — standard Web APIs present in both browsers and Node 22, but not in the ES2022 lib. DOM is the dependency-free way to type them; the alternative, @types/node, would be a new dependency AND would wrongly imply this package is Node-only. Nothing here touches document or window.
